description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath proposed linking government employees' performance and achievements with their ACRs and promotions. Addressing a Mission Karmayogi workshop in Lucknow, he announced plans for an AI Centre of Excellence and stronger local body training, stressing accountability, citizen satisfaction and timely grievance resolution across departments.
body_lead: Lucknow, October 23: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath stated that when a common man has to move from one office to another to get a task done, it raises serious questions about the entire system. If an elderly person, youth, woman, farmer, or someone in need has to return disappointed without a time-bound resolution, the purpose of public service remains unfulfilled. Citizen satisfaction is the report card of any public servant.
